description: This file contains the implementation of MigraDoc's Document Object Model (DOM) message handling, including localized text strings and error message generators for various validation and parsing scenarios.

classes.name: MdDomMsgs
classes.description: A static class providing factory methods for generating localized message objects used throughout MigraDoc's Document Object Model.

methods.name: StyleExpected
methods.description: Generates a message indicating that a value must be of type 'Style', but a different type was provided.

methods.name: BaseStyleRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a base style name must be defined.

methods.name: EmptyBaseStyle
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that setting an empty base style is invalid.

methods.name: InvalidFieldFormat
methods.description: Indicates that a given format string is not a valid numeric field format.

methods.name: InvalidInfoFieldName
methods.description: Indicates an invalid 'Name' property value for an InfoField.

methods.name: UndefinedBaseStyle
methods.description: Indicates that the base style of a specified style is undefined.

methods.name: InvalidValueName
methods.description: Indicates that a provided value name is invalid.

methods.name: InvalidUnitValue
methods.description: Indicates that a string is not a valid value for the 'Unit' structure.

methods.name: InvalidUnitType
methods.description: Indicates that a unit type string is unknown.

methods.name: InvalidEnumValue
methods.description: Indicates that a value is not valid for a specific enum type.

methods.name: InvalidEnumForLeftPosition
methods.description: Specifies that ShapePosition must be 'Left', 'Center', or 'Right'.

methods.name: InvalidEnumForTopPosition
methods.description: Specifies that ShapePosition must be 'Top', 'Center', or 'Bottom'.

methods.name: InvalidColorString
methods.description: Indicates that a color string could not be parsed.

methods.name: InvalidFontSize
methods.description: Indicates that a font size value is out of the acceptable range.

methods.name: InsertNullNotAllowed
methods.description: Indicates that inserting null is not permitted.

methods.name: ParentAlreadySet
methods.description: Indicates that a DocumentObject's parent has already been set and must be cloned before reuse.

methods.name: MissingObligatoryProperty
methods.description: Indicates that an obligatory property has not been set.

methods.name: InvalidDocumentObjectType
methods.description: Indicates that a document object is invalid in the current context.

methods.name: SymbolExpected
methods.description: Indicates that a specific symbol was expected during parsing.

methods.name: EndOfFileExpected
methods.description: Indicates that the end of the file was expected.

methods.name: UnexpectedEndOfFile
methods.description: Indicates an unexpected end of file was encountered.

methods.name: StyleNameExpected
methods.description: Indicates that a style name was expected but not found.

methods.name: UnexpectedSymbol
methods.description: Indicates an unexpected symbol was encountered.

methods.name: IdentifierExpected
methods.description: Indicates that an identifier was expected.

methods.name: BoolValueExpected
methods.description: Indicates that a boolean value was expected.

methods.name: RealValueExpected
methods.description: Indicates that a real (floating-point) value was expected.

methods.name: IntegerValueExpected
methods.description: Indicates that an integer value was expected.

methods.name: StringValueExpected
methods.description: Indicates that a string value was expected.

methods.name: NullValueExpected
methods.description: Indicates that a null value was expected.

methods.name: NumberValueExpected
methods.description: Indicates that a numeric value was expected.

methods.name: InvalidEnum
methods.description: Indicates that a token does not correspond to a valid enum value.

methods.name: InvalidType
methods.description: Indicates an unsupported variable type.

methods.name: InvalidAssignment
methods.description: Indicates an invalid assignment to a variable.

methods.name: InvalidRange
methods.description: Indicates that a specified range is invalid.

methods.name: InvalidColor
methods.description: Indicates that a color token is invalid.

methods.name: InvalidFieldType
methods.description: Indicates an invalid field type.

methods.name: InvalidValueForOperation
methods.description: Indicates that an operation is not valid for a given value.

methods.name: InvalidSymbolType
methods.description: Indicates a symbol is not valid in the current context.

methods.name: MissingBraceLeft
methods.description: Indicates a missing left brace.

methods.name: MissingBraceRight
methods.description: Indicates a missing right brace.

methods.name: MissingBracketLeft
methods.description: Indicates a missing left bracket.

methods.name: MissingBracketRight
methods.description: Indicates a missing right bracket.

methods.name: MissingParenLeft
methods.description: Indicates a missing left parenthesis.

methods.name: MissingParenRight
methods.description: Indicates a missing right parenthesis.

methods.name: MissingComma
methods.description: Indicates a missing comma.

methods.name: SymbolNotAllowed
methods.description: Indicates that a symbol is not allowed in the current context.

methods.name: SymbolIsNotAnObject
methods.description: Indicates that a symbol is not an object.

methods.name: UnknownChartType
methods.description: Indicates an unknown chart type.

methods.name: NoAccess
methods.description: Indicates access is denied, for internal use only.

methods.name: NewlineInString
methods.description: Indicates that a newline in a string is not allowed.

methods.name: EscapeSequenceNotAllowed
methods.description: Indicates an invalid escape sequence.

methods.name: NullAssignmentNotSupported
methods.description: Indicates that assigning null to a property is not allowed.

methods.name: OutOfRange
methods.description: Indicates that a value is out of the valid range.

methods.name: UseOfUndefinedBaseStyle
methods.description: Indicates usage of an undefined base style.

methods.name: UseOfUndefinedStyle
methods.description: Indicates usage of an undefined style.
